	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_stabilo.30.a
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				has_country_flag = zin_east_in_crisis
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				NOT = {
					stability > 0.4
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				check_variable = { zin_east_lean < -30 }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				check_variable = { zin_east_lean < -60 }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -30
				has_country_flag = zin_east_owes_temples
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_stabilo_great_loan
			}
			add_political_power = 100
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 30 }
			zin_stabilo_add_debt = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = zin_stabilo_credit
				days = 365
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 15 }
			zin_stabilo_add_debt = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
		clr_country_flag = zin_stabilo_great_loan
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_stabilo.30.b
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 60
			modifier = {
				add = -30
				has_country_flag = zin_east_in_crisis
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -20
				NOT = {
					stability > 0.4
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				has_country_flag = zin_east_owes_temples
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = zin_stabilo_great_loan
	}
}
